# PEPPER / DisPo pipeline — pinned Python dependencies.

# Versions are those of the environment in which run_016 artefacts were
# last regenerated and verified (2026-08-03). Pin exactly: the Monte Carlo
# stage is expected to be bit-for-bit reproducible, and a numpy or scipy
# minor bump can silently change the last digits of a float.

#   python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate
#   pip install -r agentic_pipeline/env/requirements.txt
#
